import MeasureTheory.Measure.Kernel
import MeasureTheory.Measure.Singular
import MeasureTheory.Measure.SingularPart

open ProbabilityTheory

theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {γ : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} [hαγ : MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated α γ] (κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α γ) [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel η] : Measurable fun a => (κ a).singularPart (η a) := by
  have h1 : ∀ a, (κ a).isFiniteMeasure := by intros a; exact (IsFiniteKernel.isFiniteMeasure κ)
  have h2 : ∀ a, (η a).isFiniteMeasure := by intros a; exact (IsFiniteKernel.isFiniteMeasure η)
  have h3 : ∀ a, (κ a).isRegular := by intros a; exact (IsFiniteKernel.isRegular κ)
  have h4 : ∀ a, (η a).isRegular := by intros a; exact (IsFiniteKernel.isRegular η)

  let f : α → Measure γ := fun a => (κ a).singularPart (η a)

  have h5 : Measurable f :=
    by
      intro a
      apply measurable_singularity
      exact (IsFiniteKernel.isFiniteMeasure κ).symm
      exact (IsFiniteKernel.isFiniteMeasure η).symm
      exact (IsFiniteKernel.isRegular κ).symm
      exact (IsFiniteKernel.isRegular η).symm
      exact (MeasurableSpace.countableOrCountablyGenerated α γ).countableOrCountablyGenerated
